item.title: PARKY CHARTER: Petition supported by Chorleywood charity debated in Parliament
item.description: The Parky Charter, which calls for increased funding and care for those with Parkinson’s, was debated in Parliament on Monday, November 17. The petition acquired 113,439 signatures, including much support from the charity Cure Parkinson’s. item.description: West Hertfordshire Teaching Hospitals NHS Trust was crowned NHS Trust of the Year on Thursday, November 20.
